sources.identifier: doi:10.1136/bmj.c2249; PMC2871988 version 2; Bao et al. 2010
sources.population: Shanghai Diabetes Study II, 2007-2008: 4886 Chinese adults over 20 without known diabetes. Excluded cancer, severe psychiatric disturbance, chronic kidney disease, pregnancy and glucocorticoid treatment; 360 previously diagnosed diabetes, 87 missing questionnaires and 39 under 20 excluded from 5372 participants. Multistage stratified community sample.
sources.measurement: 10-hour overnight fast. Venous plasma glucose by glucose oxidase, fasting and after 75 g oral glucose. HbA1c by high-performance liquid chromatography; percent. BMI kg/m^2. Table 1 uses medians/IQR unless stated; correlation in Results explicitly Pearson.

sources.identifier: doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0296694; PMC10810428 version 1; Wang et al. 2024
sources.population: MIND-China 2018-2019, 3547 rural Shandong adults aged 61-80, free of dementia/disability, 57.8% women; missing blood glucose or diabetes history excluded. Includes diagnosed and treated diabetes; 506 diabetes by FPG >=7 or treatment/history, 3041 without that definition. Continuous covariate missingness filled by mean, categorical by mode. Independent of SHDS II and Dutch Lifelines; no overlapping persons are claimed.
sources.measurement: Overnight fasting venous serum glucose: clot, centrifugation, glucose oxidase in local town laboratory within 2 h. Fluoride plasma glucose: hexokinase at central KingMed laboratory same day. HbA1c: EDTA blood, HPLC at KingMed within two days, NGSP-certified. Correlation explicitly Spearman, not Pearson. Target central serum glucose is not identical handling.

sources.identifier: doi:10.1111/joim.12010; PMID 23121487; Jansen et al. 2013; original-study abstract only
sources.population: 2921 nondiabetic adults in northern Netherlands Lifelines. Only gateway registered bibliographic metadata and original-study abstract were accessible; full exclusions, tables and coefficient definitions unavailable.
sources.measurement: Abstract reports BMI, fasting plasma glucose, HbA1c, erythrocyte indices, smoking, alcohol and genotypes. Full assay details and individual coefficients not extracted because full text unavailable.
